prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS2 mean temperature 41.6 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS1 mean temperature 36.0 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.37 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 403 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.7 % (7% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (within 2% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.393 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS4 mean temperature 31.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.38 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 402 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.8 % (6% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.5 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
